delete.description:
Erase all data for this tenant.

Refused with 409 session_in_progress while this tenant's voice session runs (another tenant's session does not
block it). Then, in this order: the voice host is taken off this tenant if it works for them, and the delegate's
work for them is cancelled and waited out; their running finalisations are cancelled; their event stream, replay
buffer, meeting buses and profile cache entry are dropped; then their rows go and their files.

With tenant isolation on the tenant's schema is dropped, under the provisioner's lock and after the tenant
leaves its ready set, so the next request starts from a new, empty schema. With isolation off every
tenant-owned table is emptied in one transaction (the gate ledger through its erase door); the shared schema
and schema_migrations stay.

Files: only the tenant's directory under the data directory (tenant_files_dir). Downloaded models only with
?models=true.

Requires header: X-Confirm: delete-all
Returns 204 on success. The contract specifies no body on 204.

get.description:
Export this tenant's data as a streaming gzip-compressed tar archive.

Layout (stable across engine versions):
  manifest.json          -- {schema_version, tenant, exported_at, counts: {table: n}, files}
  tables/<table>.jsonl   -- one JSON object per row per line, all columns
  files/...              -- the tenant's files (tenant_files_dir), paths preserved

Rows are read in pages from a server-side cursor; the archive is compressed in a worker thread, so a large
tenant neither fills memory nor holds up the event loop the wake path runs on.

Requires header: X-Confirm: export
Returns 200 with Content-Type: application/gzip.

post.description: Create a new meeting.

Make a scribe from a transcript someone already has: pasted text, a transcript file (.txt, .md, .srt, .vtt) or a
YouTube link (its captions).

A transcript file is sent as `text` with its `filename` (a browser cannot give the engine a path), or as `path` from
the desktop app. A YouTube link needs connectors to be allowed (403 `network_disabled` otherwise). Audio files cannot
be transcribed here yet (501 `not_implemented`). Returns {meetingId, jobId}: the work runs in the background and a
`job.update` event says when it is done (`done`) or why it could not be (`error`, with the reason); a failed import
leaves no half-made scribe behind.

post.description:
Commit an edit session on a scribe atomically: title, context and project, transcript lines, the summary and
tasks in one transaction. Every piece carries the revision the person last saw; if any changed, nothing is written
and the 409 `revision_conflict` lists the pieces (`items`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe:
a commit that already succeeded answers again with the same body. 400 for a bad value anywhere (nothing written).
Trigger enrichment for all non-edited blocks.

needs a body of `{"overwriteEdits": true}`.

post.description: Add a task by hand. The same title twice in one scribe is a 409.

Draft tasks from the transcript (and the scribe's project, when it has one).

Adds only titles the scribe does not have yet, so it is safe to run again: tasks that are done, edited or written
by hand are never touched or repeated. Answers `{created, skipped}`. 409 until the scribe has finished and has a
transcript; 503 when the AI is not running; 502 when its answer cannot be used (try again).

post.description:
Power and session events forwarded by the app (Electron powerMonitor).

sleep pauses the capture watchdog; wake (or an unlock that follows a missed wake) reopens the
microphone stream after a short delay so the voice host is armed on a live stream. Lock alone
changes nothing. Returns handled=False when the engine runs without an audio engine.

post.description:
DEBUG ONLY: bypass the wake gate and start a wake session immediately.

Only reachable when the server was started with --debug-trigger. --no-auth
alone does not enable it: the normal launch runs with --no-auth, and any
local process could otherwise start a fake wake.
Use for automated roomplay tests where a synthetic voice does not wake the gate.
Returns {meeting_id} once the session has one (up to about 2 s).
